subject: spanish
title: Stretch: Personality and Relationships
welcome_lead: Stretch yourself by describing personalities and explaining how you get on with people.
meta_desc: GCSE Spanish stretch adventure on personality vocabulary and relationships.
final_note: ¡Fantástico! You can now write rich personality descriptions.

concepts.def: I get on well with — relationship phrase.

walkthroughs.body_html: Use ser for permanent traits: Mi padre es trabajador y divertido. Common personality adjectives: simpático (nice), antipático (unpleasant), generoso, egoísta (selfish), tímido, hablador (talkative).

Me llevo bien con mi hermana = I get on well with my sister. The negative: Me llevo mal con... (I don't get on with). Add a reason: porque es divertida (because she is fun) or porque es egoísta (because she is selfish).

Higher-mark answers always include a reason. Pattern: opinion + porque + es + adjective. Example: Mi mejor amigo es genial porque es muy gracioso y siempre me ayuda (My best friend is great because he is very funny and always helps me).

mcqs.q: What does 'me llevo bien con' mean?

numericals.q: In 'Tengo dos hermanos y tres hermanas', how many siblings in total?

free_texts.q: Write the Spanish word for 'because' (no accents).
